source_slug: 2026-02-20 Malawi validates AI strategy, digital transformation policy - CAJ News Africa

fact: Malawi launched regional consultation workshops to develop its first National AI Strategy, led by the Department of E-Government with UNDP and the PPPC; document published 2025-09-25, event date not given.
ICT minister Namalomba said on 2026-08-06 that the government is finalising a National AI Strategy, to be supported by an AI Bill.

The Ministry of ICT's Department of E-Government opened a two-day national validation workshop on the Draft National AI Strategy in Lilongwe, to validate it before finalisation; the strategy is not yet adopted.
The Principal Secretary of the Department of eGovernment said the National AI Strategy has been drafted and is in stakeholder consultation before adoption.
